title: Layout Template
description: Panel grid layout template. Defines precise pixel geometry for each panel position on a page.

layout_id.description: Immutable slug. Must match the filename (e.g. layout_02.yaml -> layout_02).

bleed_px.description: Bleed margin in pixels around the outer edge of the page.

panels.description: Ordered list of panel definitions. Position values must be unique and geometrically consistent. The plan parser validates arithmetic on load.

position.description: Panel position number within the layout. Must be unique within this layout.

x.description: Left edge of the panel in pixels from page origin.

y.description: Top edge of the panel in pixels from page origin.

width_px.description: Panel width in pixels. Passed to the image generator as the generation dimension.

height_px.description: Panel height in pixels. Passed to the image generator as the generation dimension.

composition_hint.description: Advisory composition suggestion for this panel position. Does not override the Chapter Plan's shot_type.
